title: Working on an ad for my game, is it a hit or miss?
author: Ukawok92
selftext:
I'm trying to come up with a short ad I can run on TikTok.

Would this catch your attention, or would you just swipe up as soon as you saw it?

comments.author: ALbera_Uhata
comments.body: At first glance, it looks like a video.

comments.author: Shalke97
comments.body: Brother, you joined the false advertising gang. My Smile dropped when it cut to a tetris game. I expected a jump and run with nice graphics.

comments.author: StellarSoupStudio
comments.body: I would swipe past, what you've shown lacks cohesion. What does the fox have to do with the match 3 game and what does any of that have to do with space?

replies.author: Ukawok92
replies.body:
Fair, it will seem clear to me since I know the game so well.

In VS mode, animals are the bosses and the fox is one of them. The entire game uses the solar system as the level selection, the VS games are on earth, puzzle levels are on different planets, time trial is on the moon...

https://i.redd.it/rlmruvksqezh1.png

comments.author: livingFaithGame
comments.body: at 00:13 the foxes kinda melt in to each other

comments.author: MrMegaPhoenix
comments.body:
The fox head clips through the other 

It also looks like a mobile phone ad that I don’t pay attention to while trying to get bonus gold

comments.author: GigaTerra
comments.body: You should make it puzzle blocks that fall from the sky. Me personally I would make an rough version of the video in Blender, and then feed it to AI to prevent any AI merging or clipping.

comments.author: gholias
comments.body: Don't do AI videos to promote video games. It hurts AI game development.

replies.author: Ukawok92
replies.body: Feedback noted. I'll work on a new trailer/ad that just uses gameplay video.

comments.author: Bratchan
comments.body: Remove the AI gen video.. just do game play. Mobile games we don't care about fake shit.. all we want to know is the game play what we want. We want to dump hours into mindels games.. not watch some trailer that part of it has nothing to do really with the gaame. If you have story put it in the game not trailers. Mobile audience is very mind numbe to too much AI and fake stuff. We just want to know what the game is.. so when we download it.. we dont' be disappointed.

replies.author: Ukawok92
replies.body:
Fair criticism. I'm not sold on this video either, but wanted to experiment with Gemini video.

I'll work on a new trailer that just focuses on gameplay.

comments.author: AritoSoto
comments.body:
There was fox, then there was big rock block falling out of nowhere, then there was 2D unrelated game with squirrelxfox hybrid(?) then there was planets and space theme?  
I didn't understand what was the concept or story was but both video looks very AI and game doesn't feel anything special. It would be hard to notice with all the AI content taking over social media I do not think your intro stands out.

replies.author: Ukawok92
replies.body:
The first clip of the gameplay shows a concrete slab falling into the game area, was hoping showing that first would make it clear the connection to the CGI slab, I guess not.

And fair about the space at the end. Gotta remember that people don't know my game and won't understand why that's there. (The entire games menu system revolves around space, different levels live on different planets.

replies.author: AritoSoto
replies.body:
Very cool but I think your game has clash of concepts. Some parts looks nature/calm/asmr, some parts look puzzle/solving or space, they are constantly fighting with each other.   
I wouldn't add anything to my game if it's not contributing to the atmosphere, creating coherence or helping me explain mechanics/logics of the game.   
Everything you add that do not serves a purpose will confuse the players and take unwanted attention.  
Most basic example is foxes on the screen. I am playing the game but there is couple of animals  that are not only in whole different art-style but also constantly moving. Especially in puzzle games understandability and clearity should be your top goals as much as coherence of the art.

replies.author: Ukawok92
replies.body:
Maybe it would make more sense when you play the full game. In VS mode, levels are scattered on earth. Tried to have the background be the environment the animal boss your facing would live in. For example this is the beaver level.

Puzzle levels live on different planets, time trial on the moon. My ad clearly doesn't explain it all very well.

https://i.redd.it/7u2o4qkytezh1.png

comments.author: Old-Preference5313
comments.body: This is atrocious, don't release this add. It's some of the worst ai generated video content  and voiceover I've seen

comments.author: Acidswtf
comments.body: I dont get the switch from foxes to fckn planets at the end lol

replies.author: Ukawok92
replies.body:
Yeah, this ad is a flop. It doesn't explain that well.

The solar system is the games menu basically. VS CPU levels live on earth, each boss is a different animal.

https://reddit.com/link/1xmtzic/video/jgwdcxpkuezh1/player

comments.author: lordaloa
comments.body:
Oh no, no this is bad.  
noticable AI art, from looks repetitive gameplay loop, disconnected styles. Generic UI and fonts. No, sorry but this is just bland as it can get.

comments.author: PulIthEld
comments.body:
The foxes in the bottom right at :12 are clipping through eachother.

The tiles in the game look terrible compared to the video and surrounding graphics.

replies.author: Ukawok92
replies.body: Interesting, your one of the few commenters who likes it.

comments.author: barret232hxc
comments.body: the ads that show stuff that's not the game which I assume the beginning of the ad is, always bother me. just show me the gameplay not some cgi that is not the actual game
